text: Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list) explicitly refutes, argues against, contradicts or debunks a specific example or anecdote given by the OP, judged within that single comment alone. OP title and argument are context used only to identify the OP's examples/anecdotes. Output 0 if no comment does (e.g. comments only address the general premise, or only agree with or mention an example without refuting it), and 0 for an empty valid comment list. Output null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP text needed to identify examples is missing. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement. Comment order is irrelevant; use the current supplied text without inferring earlier snapshots.
